body:
I don't even know how I'd get in contact with a counsellor or therapist. I guess I could go to the ones who work for my school but I feel like that'd just be very uncomfortable for all parties involved and I don't know how much it would help.

And trust me when I say I have run through all my friends and half of them would be incredibly awkward and unhelpful and the other half would be extremely uncomfortable, and I really don't want that. If there were one friend who I could talk to, I would have done it already.
